response.sql: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT account_id, amount, balance, type, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount ELSE NULL END AS signed_amount FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS signed_count FROM filtered_trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN signed_count > 0 THEN avg_signed_amount END), AVG(avg_balance) FROM account_stats;

alternatives.interpretation: Only accounts with at least one signed transaction (PRIJEM or VYDAJ with amount >= 2400) are included when computing both figures, interpreting the constraint as applying to both rather than just the first.
alternatives.sql: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT account_id, amount, balance, type, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount ELSE NULL END AS signed_amount FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), account_stats AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance, COUNT(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS signed_count FROM filtered_trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount), AVG(avg_balance) FROM account_stats WHERE signed_count > 0;
